dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by muted grays and deep greens of moss and shadows.  Dim, ethereal light filters through the mist, casting long, dancing shadows.
dna.atmosphere: The air is cool and damp, thick with a spectral mist that clings to everything. A palpable sense of stillness pervades, broken only by the faintest whispers of wind through the ruins.
dna.materials: Primarily ancient, weathered stone with patches of damp, clinging moss. Cobwebs drape across surfaces, and the floor is littered with debris.
dna.mood: Melancholy and eerie, evoking a sense of lost grandeur and lingering spectral presence.
dna.sounds: Whispering wind, distant echoes, creaking stone, rustling moss, faint spectral moans
dna.accent_features: Crumbling gargoyles, shattered stained glass fragments, overgrown archways
dna.cultural_tone: Remnants of a forgotten noble house

niche-1767618717546-bwc452tyy.name: Castle Ruins

dna.looks: Vast, irregular stone structures that have succumbed to time. Battlements are fractured, and walls lean precariously. Overgrown with spectral moss, the ruins suggest immense age and decay.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by muted grays of ancient stone and the deep, somber greens of persistent moss. Dim, ethereal light filters through the pervasive mist, casting elongated, dancing shadows.
dna.atmosphere: The air is perpetually cool and damp, thick with a spectral mist that clings to every surface. A profound stillness permeates the space, disturbed only by the faintest, mournful whispers of wind weaving through the hollows.
dna.materials: Primarily ancient, weathered stone, heavily textured and worn. Damp, clinging spectral moss covers large swathes, softening sharp edges. Cobwebs are prevalent, draping across surfaces, and the ground is littered with fallen stone and debris.
dna.mood: Melancholy and eerie, a palpable sense of lost grandeur and lingering spectral presence.
dna.sounds: Whispering wind, creaking stone, distant echoes, faint rustling.
dna.spatialLayout: A sprawling, fragmented complex of interconnected courtyards and chambers, many collapsed. The layout is irregular and organic, following the natural terrain and defensive needs of a forgotten age.
dna.primary_surfaces: Weathered, crumbling stone and spectral moss
dna.accent_features: Crumbling gargoyles, shattered stained glass fragments, overgrown archways, remnants of heraldic carvings
dna.secondary: Deep green moss clinging to northern faces and archways
dna.accent: Ethereal white mist clinging low to the ground
dna.cultural_tone: Remnants of a forgotten noble house

niche-1767618717546-bwc452tyy.description: You step into the vast, echoing interior of the castle ruins. Crumbling stone walls rise around you, punctuated by narrow slits that offer glimpses of the overgrown grounds outside. The air is thick with dust and the scent of damp earth, and cobwebs hang like tattered curtains. It feels ancient and forgotten.
